scientific_question: Does paper-style layer/target-wise allocation that generates only the functionally simpler Q/K score map and keeps the more curved V/O residual branch dense close the 124M/20TPP partial-attention gap?

theory_synthesis.paper_mechanism: Use LWT-style target-specific allocation when different layers or parameter families occupy different manifolds; do not force one uniform latent chart across incompatible functions.
theory_synthesis.score_geometry: The causal-softmax probability path was materially simpler than the raw Q/K score-kernel path: path/chord 1.3697 and PC1 energy 0.9274.
theory_synthesis.value_output_geometry: The residual head-contribution path was more curved than the V/O kernel: path/chord 2.0676 and PC1 energy 0.8071; direct joint V/O directions had effectively zero held-out task alignment.
theory_synthesis.causal_training_evidence: At 5TPP QK-only beat QK+V by 0.0290 CE at terminal and beat the fair blockwise-dense control by 0.0252 CE. At 20TPP QK+V ended +0.0306 CE behind dense. The measured magnitudes identify generated V, not Q/K, as the unresolved partial-attention penalty.
theory_synthesis.architecture_boundary: The accepted residual-write-preserving joint run independently showed that generated Q/K/V and procedural c_fc compose when both c_proj residual writes stay dense. This experiment refines the attention feature allocation only; it does not reopen either c_proj family or change the MLP.

candidate.mlp: fully dense Muon control; no MLP generator is enabled
candidate.qk_recipe: exact inherited QK64 bilateral Cayley, output-side Cayley, output gain, scale 1.0, Cayley subgroup LR scale 10/3, and fixed seeds
candidate.frozen_training: From-scratch model/data seeds, LR 2.4e-3, minimum LR 2.4e-4, Muon/AdamW fallback recipe, batch, dataset, weight decay, and fixed evaluation windows are unchanged from the accepted 5TPP QK-only parent.

decision_rule.pass: Accept generated-QK/dense-V/dense-c_proj as the 124M/20TPP functional-LWT partial-attention endpoint. Do not call it full attention replacement. Only then may a separate plan compose the accepted c_fc procedure.
decision_rule.fail: Reject the 5TPP QK-only advantage as non-transferable to 20TPP and launch no capacity, seed, or optimizer sweep.

monitoring.expected_duration: approximately 4-5 hours based on the matched QK+V 20TPP run
monitoring.policy: one idempotent aggregate watchdog because the run exceeds two hours
monitoring.callback_action_prompt: @Codex verify the live or terminal state against the active project note; inspect fixed losses, GPU health, provenance, and checkpoint identity; update durable evidence; on terminal classify the functional-LWT gate and continue autonomously. Do not merely acknowledge.

scope_guards: This is partial attention allocation, not full attention replacement.
V and both attention/MLP c_proj residual-write maps remain dense.
The MLP remains completely dense in this causal discriminator.
Generated weights are materialized; no inference parameter or FLOP reduction is claimed.
No MFU test or training run may start before this plan and exact config are committed and synchronized into a clean PRO6 worktree.
No automatic rerun, alternate rank, generated-V repair, MLP composition, larger model, or different token rung is authorized.
